config_coupling.effect: The backup copy retries SQLITE_BUSY or SQLITE_LOCKED step failures up to 100 times, waiting 50 milliseconds between attempts unless canceled. A successful step resets the consecutive retry counter. Other errors fail immediately. The restore copy does not use this retry loop.
config_coupling.source: Compile-time sqlitedb constants backupRetryLimit = 100 and backupRetryBackoff = 50 milliseconds; waitBackupRetry also observes the caller context.
